Subject: Quick recap + request: who owns budget & expected purchase signal?

Hi Aisha / Sam — thanks again for the demo earlier. Short recap and two asks so we can align internal resources on our side:

- Recap: We walked through Redwood inference hosted + dedicated options, showed the 99th percentile latency on your sample prompts, and discussed integration patterns (prefix caching + automated batching) to hit your 95ms target for triage workflows.
- Items agreed: 1) pilot with 50k tokens/month, 2) 60-day trial window, 3) security questionnaire to be completed by next week.

Two asks from our side:
1) Who at GrayBridge signs off on the budget for this pilot (title / name / best email)? We want to make sure we loop the right fiscal owner before drafting procurement paperwork.
2) What will be your internal signal that indicates a purchase decision after the pilot? (e.g., PO issued, finance approval, vendor onboarding ticket).

I attached the short procurement checklist we use (procurement-checklist-GBH.xlsx) and the recording from today’s demo. If you prefer, we can draft a one-page mutual action plan once you confirm the budget owner.

Next steps I propose: if you share the budget owner, I’ll loop in our contracts lead (Laura) to surface standard timelines and any docs you’ll need. If you’d rather I intro to procurement directly, happy to do that.

Thanks — appreciate the time.

—Connor

Hi Connor — great session, thanks. Quick answers below:

- Budget owner: I believe finance will sign off, but the day-to-day sponsor is me (Director, Clinical Innovation). Final approval will come from Priya Nair, VP Finance. Priya's email: priya.nair@graybridgehealth.com.
- Purchase signal: For pilots under $50k we usually route via a vendor onboarding form and a PO from finance. For anything above that threshold we need an approval note from VP Finance. So the signal is: PO issued (preferred) or explicit written approval from Priya.

On security: our procurement team copied here (procurement@graybridgehealth.com) will send the SOC2 questionnaire and the data handling matrix. Expect that to land tomorrow.

If you can draft a one-pager MA P (mutual action plan) that lists milestones and what we’d need for a PO, that’ll help Priya move faster.

Cheers,
